root_cause: BoxDecoration.background_blend_mode, BoxShadow.blur_style and DecorationImage.center_slice / match_text_direction were stored but the decoration painter never read them.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/box_painter.rs: needs_full_painter includes a blend mode; decorated() wraps the background fill in a Blend layer (Flutter _getBackgroundPaint), styled_shadow() composes solid/outer/inner as opacity(alpha, [blur(opaque shape), shape | DstOut(shape) | DstIn(shape)]) matching SkBlurMask s+b-sb, b(1-s), bs; paint_image() ports Flutter paintImage (applyBoxFit, center-slice border arithmetic, drawImageNine with proportional corner shrink, repeat tiles, flip about the rect centre with mirrored alignment); match_text_direction reads the ambient Directionality from the LayoutBuilder context. decoration.rs doc comments updated. lib.rs re-exports BlurStyle (it was unreachable from the crate root).
harness: no scenario; pixel scenes proposed for the orchestrator (see md)
api_change: BlurStyle now re-exported from incular_widgets; behavior of the four parameters changes from ignored to painted
limitations: Blur styles are composed from existing blur/blend/opacity layers (one extra offscreen group per non-normal shadow). Background blend reads whatever the current render target holds below the fill, like a Flutter paint blend in the same layer. Nine-slice/flip images paint through a CustomPaint display list rather than the Image render object.
note: WGPU executes the Blend groups through the existing fixed-function and destination-read paths.

root_cause: BackdropFilter, its WidgetKind/RenderKind, LayerKind::BackdropFilter and PaintCommand::PushBackdropFilter carry only a blur and an optional matrix.
change: crates/incular-rendering/src/effects.rs: renderer-neutral ImageFilter (Blur, Matrix, Dilate, Erode, Color, Compose with stages()), ImageFilterTarget, UnsupportedImageFilter (Display + Error). crates/incular-widgets/src/compositing.rs: BackdropFilter::image_filter(filter, child) -> Result accepts a single blur or matrix and returns UnsupportedImageFilter{target: Backdrop} for color, dilate, erode and multi-stage compositions.
limitations: Executing color/dilate/erode/compose on a backdrop needs a filter value threaded through WidgetKind::BackdropFilter (tree/specs.rs), RenderKind and render_object/layers.rs, the compositor create/update API, PaintCommand::PushBackdropFilter and a WGPU BackdropOp per stage (color: run_color_matrix_pass over a full-target capture; morphology: a new separable min/max pass). Those files are outside paint-2 ownership and are matched in ~40 places.
note: Unsupported forms are refused at construction, never drawn as another filter.

root_cause: ImageFiltered only lowered to a Blur layer.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/images.rs: ImageFiltered::new(ImageFilter, child) -> Result; From<ImageFiltered> folds the flattened stages inner-first: blur -> asymmetric Blur layer, color -> ColorFiltered (any ColorFilter incl. gamma/blend stages), matrix -> WidgetKind::Transform about the top-left with transform_hit_tests false (Flutter ImageFilterLayer transforms paint, not hit testing). Dilate/erode return UnsupportedImageFilter{target: Subtree}.
limitations: Dilate/erode have no subtree layer (needs a LayerKind/PaintCommand/RenderKind morphology stage and a WGPU min/max pass); refused with a typed error. Matrix semantics are a retained transform (vector-resampled) rather than a raster resample of the child, and semantics bounds follow the transform. The disabled path still returns the bare child (pre-existing).

root_cause: ColorFilter was a 4x5 matrix only; gamma filters and the non-affine ColorFilter.mode modes had no representation or shader stage.
change: crates/incular-rendering/src/effects.rs: ColorFilter gains a ColorFilterStage (None, LinearToSrgbGamma, SrgbToLinearGamma, Blend{color, mode}) applied before the matrix; ColorFilter::linear_to_srgb_gamma/srgb_to_linear_gamma/blend(color, mode) (exact matrix when one exists, stage otherwise); try_then (then panics only for an unfusable staged pair); EffectChain::optimized uses try_then; apply() runs the stage; linear_to_srgb/srgb_to_linear exported. compositor.rs (additive): stage bits in the colour-filter cache fingerprint. crates/incular-wgpu: color_matrix_shader.wgsl runs the stage (sRGB transfer functions, the full blend_premultiplied formula set); GpuColorMatrixParams gains stage + colour; EffectCacheEntry.stage_bits keys the cache; nested colour filters fuse via try_then only.
api_change: additive constructors; ColorFilter has a private stage field (struct was already opaque); ColorFilter::then documents a panic for a staged filter after a non-identity matrix (use try_then)
limitations: GPU test runs on the local adapter (passed); it skips without one unless INCULAR_WGPU_REQUIRE_GPU=1.

change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/shape_borders.rs: ContinuousRectangleBorder (Flutter _getPath cubics, radii clamped to the shortest side, x/y radius swap as in Flutter, inner path deflated by side.width, stroke of the outer path) and LinearBorder + LinearBorderEdge (dimensions per present edge, Flutter paint incl. hairline strokes and its origin quirks, NONE/start/end/top/bottom, lerp). Re-exported from painting_effects.rs and lib.rs.
limitations: ShapeBorder::paint has no text direction, so LinearBorder paints left-to-right (start = left).
note: Completes the five shapes named in the finding.

root_cause: RawImage/Image lacked centerSlice, matchTextDirection and colorBlendMode.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs (Image section): Image.fit is Option (null fit = scale-down, fill with a slice, as Flutter), Image::center_slice, Image::match_text_direction (Builder reads Directionality; nine-slice/flip paint through box_painter::painted_image while a hidden maintain-size Visibility keeps the image's own layout). images.rs: RawImage::color_blend_mode (ColorFilter::blend), center_slice, match_text_direction.
limitations: isAntiAlias is not added: the image paint command has no anti-alias flag and Incular's image quads are not edge-AA'd differently; recorded rather than stored-and-ignored.

root_cause: FadeInImage error builders need image load failures; FadeInImage takes pre-decoded ImageHandles, so no load can fail inside the widget.
change: none beyond RawImage/Image options it composes (paint-013); repeat and filter qualities were added by the earlier paint pass
limitations: imageErrorBuilder/placeholderErrorBuilder and separate colour/blend options wait on paint-012's provider-backed state.

root_cause: Re-assessed: incular-image has an ImageProvider trait and ImageCache but no asynchronous load state, stream, chunk events or multi-frame decoding, and no widget holds a provider; Image consumes a decoded ImageHandle synchronously.
limitations: Design gap: needs (1) an image-stream/load-state value in incular-image (pending, chunk progress, ready(frame), error) produced off the UI thread through incular-runtime tasks (wasm-safe), (2) a retained ProviderImage widget state keyed by provider identity that rebuilds on state changes, with gapless_playback keeping the previous handle, (3) frame_builder(context, child, frame, was_sync), loading_builder(context, child, progress) and error_builder(context, error) hooks plus exclude_from_semantics. API shape is an orchestrator decision.

root_cause: Force press is unwired: tree pointer dispatch receives incular_gestures::PointerEvent {pointer, position, phase, time}, which has no PointerSampleMetadata, so pressure from InputEvent::PointerWithMetadata never reaches gesture dispatch; there is no ForcePress arena member kind or GestureCallbacks fields.
limitations: Remaining work: carry `sample` (pressure) through incular-runtime frame.rs into dispatch_pointer_gesture_* (a new parameter or a metadata-bearing event), add on_force_press_start/peak/update/end to GestureCallbacks and GestureDetector builders, register a ForcePressGestureRecognizer member (RetainedGestureKind::ForcePress) on Down like the scale member, route Move/Up and arena accept/reject in tree/interaction.rs. Pressure is already portable in incular-core and normalized by incular-desktop; the recognizer exists. Touches runtime frame.rs and the shared interaction.rs arena paths, beyond a minimal wiring edit.

root_cause: DeviceGestureSettings (per-device touch slop from the platform view) has no counterpart; recognizers read compute_hit_slop(kind) constants.
limitations: Needs a platform-provided gesture-settings value in the environment (incular-platform metrics -> MediaQuery-like scope) and a slop parameter threaded into every recognizer's slop checks; trackpadScrollCausesScale was done earlier.

root_cause: Incular had one stateless Weighted mode; Flutter's weightedEvent/weightedContinuous are per-drag axis locks.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/advanced_scrolling/two_dimensional.rs: DiagonalDragBehavior::WeightedEvent and ::WeightedContinuous; TwoDimensionalScrollable keeps a DragLock (locked axis, last offset) with start_drag, drag_update, end_drag, locked_axis implementing Flutter _evaluateLockedAxis with kTouchSlop (incular_gestures::constants::TOUCH_SLOP). Weighted is kept and documented as Incular-specific.
api_change: additive enum variants (exhaustive matches on DiagonalDragBehavior outside the crate must add arms) and drag methods
limitations: No tree gesture path drives TwoDimensionalScrollable today (apply_delta has no in-tree caller), so the lock is exercised through the model API; apply_delta treats the weighted modes as free.
